Callout.Name: Theft from a Van
Callout.Message: Tools being taken from a parked van.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, van broken into, tools on the pavement.

Script.Line: The tools are mine and the van is mine.
I was asleep in the front. That is why I did not answer.
Check the log book. It is in the glovebox.

Lines.Approach: They are unloading a van that is not theirs. The owner is a builder who is going to notice at seven.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
